Class CollisionObject

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.CollisionSystem
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an object that participates in the collision system and can contain multiple colliders. Handles collision detection, intersection, and overlap logic, and provides events and hooks for collision notifications.

public abstract class CollisionObject : PhysicsObject, IUpdateable, IDrawable

Remarks

This is an abstract base class for objects that require collision handling. It manages a set of colliders and provides advanced notification options for collision events. Inherits from PhysicsObject.

Fields

AdvancedCollisionNotification

Gets or sets whether advanced collision notification is enabled.

If set to true:

  • ColliderIntersected(Collision), ColliderOverlapped(Overlap), and ColliderContactEnded(Collider, Collider) virtual functions will be called. Override them for custom logic.
  • OnColliderIntersected, OnColliderOverlapped, and OnColliderContactEnded events will be invoked.
  • Collider-level Intersected(Collision), Overlapped(Overlap), and ContactEnded(Collider) virtual functions will be called. 
public bool AdvancedCollisionNotification

Field Value

bool

CollisionPointsFilterType

Gets or sets the filter type used when FilterCollisionPoints is enabled.

public CollisionPointsFilterType CollisionPointsFilterType

Field Value

CollisionPointsFilterType

FilterCollisionPoints

Gets or sets whether all generated collision points are filtered based on CollisionPointsFilterType.

Only colliders with ComputeIntersections enabled will generate collision points to be filtered. 

public bool FilterCollisionPoints

Field Value

bool

MotionType

Gets or sets the motion type of this object for collision detection optimizations.

Dynamic is the default and should be used for moving objects. Static is optimized for non-moving objects and can improve broadphase collision detection performance. 

public MotionType MotionType

Field Value

MotionType

Passive

Gets or sets whether this object is passive in collision calculations.

If true, when a passive object checks for collisions against non-passive objects, the collision information is generated as if the non-passive object checked for the collision. This affects collision normal direction. Only relevant for colliders that compute intersections. 

public bool Passive

Field Value

bool

ProjectShape

Gets or sets whether to project the shape for collision calculations. Uses the current velocity of the frame to project the shape. Useful for fast and/or small objects. Projecting shapes can be expensive!

public bool ProjectShape

Field Value

bool
